properties.description:
Im Heimathaus in Essenbach wird den Besuchern ein Querschnitt durch die fast 7.500 Jahre alte Besiedlungsgeschichte des mittleren Isartales geboten.  

Über 300 archäologische Fundstücke aus dem Gemeindegebiet werden dort bewahrt.

properties.name: Stadtpfarrkirche St. Nikolaus und St. Stephan in Eggenfelden
properties.description:
"Cathedral of the Rottal" is the name given to the magnificent and imposing church from the late Gothic period.

The tower of this important sacred building rises far above the houses of the charming town square.

properties.name: Hörpfad im Lohwald Neusäss
properties.description: The town of Neusäß, in cooperation with the Augsburg Office for Food, Agriculture and Forestry, has created an audio trail through the Lohwald. At a total of ten stations, children and adults can learn interesting and curious facts about the theme of the forest.

properties.name: Augsburger Dom
properties.description:
Wo heute der romanisch-gotische Dom Mariä Heimsuchung  
aufragt, standen noch im 5. Jahrhundert n. Chr. Wohnhäuser des römischen Augsburg. Eine erste Kirche wurde dort zwischen dem 5. und dem 8. Jahrhundert errichtet.

Bischof Simpert ließ einen im Jahr 807 geweihten karolingischen Neubau errichten. Die romanische Simpertkrypta ist eine der Hauptsehenswürdigkeiten des Doms.

Weil die Bischofskirche um das Jahr 994 eingestürzt war, wurde der romanische, damals noch nach Westen ausgerichtete Dom neu errichtet und 1065 geweiht.

Fünf Prophetenfenster aus dieser Zeit sind Relikte des ältesten bekannte figürlichen Glasmalereizyklus der Welt.

Erst im 14. Jahrhundert wurde der Dom nach Osten hin ausgerichtet: In mehr als hundertjähriger Bauzeit entstand der 1431 geweihte Ostchor.

Um 1350 erhielt dieser Neubau zwei Figurenportale.

Das südseitige Marienportal ist das figurenreichste Portal des 14. Jahrhunderts.

Am (weitgehend rekonstruierten) Nordportal findet man auch eine Darstellung Bischof Ulrichs sowie der Kaiserin Adelheid.

Ein Höhepunkt der barocken Ausstattung im Dom ist die Figur des Geißelheilands: ein Werk des Bildhauers Georg Petel, des „deutschen Michelangelo“.

Nirgendwo in Deutschland sieht man derart viele hochrangige Grabdenkmäler wie im Kreuzgang am Mariendom – 401 Epitaphe und Grabplatten aus der Zeit um 1350 bis 1800.

properties.name: Staatsgalerie in der Burg Burghausen
properties.description: The Bavarian State Painting Collections have set up a branch gallery on the 2nd and 3rd floors of the Palas of the main castle. The selection of 56 paintings deliberately refers to their location: on display are 15th- and 16th-century pictorial works from southern Germany or Bavaria and neighbouring Austria, as well as several large-format paintings on the history of the Bavarian dukes from the cycle of pictures painted by the Munich master Hans Werl († 1608) for the Old Hercules Hall of the Residenz in Munich. Sculptural works from the holdings of the Bayerisches National Museum (Bavarian National Museum) complement the exhibition.

properties.name: St. Vigilius Church in Kirchdorf a.H.
properties.description:
The 750th anniversary of St. Vigilius Parish Church was celebrated in autumn 2008. Accordingly, the church was founded in the mid-13th century, more precisely as the first wooden building around 1250 and as a consecrated church in 1258. At that time, Kirchdorf near Bruckmühl was appointed parish of Rott am Inn Monastery. Since a devastating fire raged in the 15th century, only the church tower has survived from the founding period. In 1470, the church was rebuilt in the Gothic style on the instructions of the nobleman Hanns von Holnstain. His tomb can still be found there today, a life-size likeness of the nobleman carved into a marble slab in the church. Although St. Vigilius Church, like many churches, was also baroquized, the wooden figures from the 15th century on the altars were preserved. At the end of the 19th century, the church underwent another stylistic transformation, back to Gothic, and received the tall, pointed church tower.

The old village cemetery is located right next to the church. The "new" cemetery, however, which was already laid out before the First World War, is a short distance away from the church.

properties.name: Pertenstein Castle
properties.description:
#### History

Water castles like that of the Hofmark Pertenstein Castle, idyllically located on the Traun between Matzing and Traunwalchen, were once typical of the Chiemgau region. Pertenstein Castle has a long history dating back to the 13th century, when Perchta von Toerring zu Stein brought the building site into her marriage with Engelbrecht von Taching. Since then, the castle has seen turbulent times, was expanded into a stately country castle, and later fell almost into ruin.

It was not until 1969 that the "Heimatbund Schloss Pertenstein e.V." saved the castle from complete decay. Today it is maintained by the association in cooperation with the Bavarian State Office for Monument Preservation. The current owner, H.S.H. Count Ignaz zu Toerring-Jettenbach, has granted it to the association under hereditary lease. Under the motto "New life in old walls," the castle now serves as a cultural and event venue. The ensemble, consisting of the castle, stables building, tithe barn, and round hall, is a sought-after location for weddings, corporate events, concerts, and more.

The castle cannot be visited, but it can be rented for celebrations or events. In addition, events such as the arts and crafts market, concerts, or song recitals take place there.

properties.name: Kunsthalle Augsburg im Glaspalast
properties.description: The Kunsthalle Augsburg (formerly H2 – The Center for Contemporary Art) on the ground floor of the Glaspalast is Augsburg's municipal museum for modern and contemporary art. Changing special exhibitions and collection presentations on 20th century art as well as contemporary art from a regional, national and international context are shown in two halls (H1 and H2) on an area totaling 2,700 square meters. Regular public guided tours and exhibition-accompanying events such as concerts, readings, artist talks or panel discussions complement the program. The museum is directed by Jan T. Wilms.

properties.name: Parish Church of the Holy Blood, Landshut
properties.description: Die Kirche geht zurück bis in die Zeit der Christianisierung im 8. Jahrhundert. Die spätgotische Kirche ist durch ihre in Altbayern einzigartigen Rundtürme bekannt. Von den barocken, klassizistischen und neugotischen Umgestaltungen blieben verschiedene wertvolle Einzelstücke in der Ausstattung erhalten.

properties.name: Lenbach-Museum
properties.description: It was an unprecedented career. Who would have guessed in 1836 that little Franz, the 13th child of a master bricklayer from Schrobenhausen, would one day rise to become a famous "painter prince"? Franz v. Lenbach (1836-1904) was one of the most important German portrait painters of the late 19th century. He painted emperors and popes, many princes and important entrepreneurs of the Gründerzeit - and not least countless female beauties. With around 500 paintings, sketches and drawings, the museum in his birthplace houses the largest collection on Franz v. Lenbach. It ranges from his artistic beginnings in 1851 to his later creative period in Munich and thus provides an excellent overview of the artist's development. Two rooms on the ground floor of the Lenbach-Museum are dedicated to Lenbach's friend and early teacher, the painter Johann Baptist Hofner (1832-1913), who became famous for his animal paintings.

properties.name: Parish Church "Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary" Unterhausen
properties.description: Die Kirche in Unterhausen birgt Bilder des Glaubens, die einen Besuch wert sind. Der Hochaltar ist geprägt von einer Madonna, die Hans Degler 1621 geschaffen hat. Das Patrozinium erinnert an die Begegnung von Maria und Elisabeth, im Deckengemälde von Johann Baptist Baader (1773) dargestellt.

properties.name: Borstei-Museum (Borstei Museum)
properties.description: "The home consolidates peace in the family, which is the foundation for peace in the state," was the credo of the founder of the Borstei housing estate, Senator Bernhard Borst, who completed it in 1929. The small museum documents his life's work and the history of Borstei. The large parks of the listed settlement have over 60 works of art that can also be visited.

properties.name: Diabetesmuseum München (Diabetes Museum Munich)
properties.description: Auf 23 qm präsentiert Familie Neumann ihre umfangreiche Sammlung zum Thema Diabetes mellitus und ermöglicht so eine Zeitreise durch die Geschichte der Zuckerkrankheit.

properties.name: Heimatmuseum Markt Schwaben (Museum of local history Markt Schwaben)
properties.description: Die Geschichte Markt Schwabens wird im Heimatmuseum unter vielfältigen Aspekten beleuchtet. 14 unterschiedliche Räume veranschaulichen die Historie des Ortes von der Vor- und Frühgeschichte bis ins Jahr 2000: steinzeitliche Grabrekonstruktionen ebenso wie Schwaben als Gerichtssitz, örtliches Handwerk und Trachten ebenso wie alte Ortsansichten oder eine „Land-Schule“. Das original eingerichtete „Poststüberl“ schließlich zeugt von der lokalen Brautradition.

properties.name: View of the Alps near Unterwendling
properties.description: Enjoy a magnificent view of the landscape from the viewpoint in Unterwendling, a district of Kelheim. On a clear day, you can even see as far as the Alps from here.

properties.name: Parish Church of St. Nicholas
properties.description:
Die Rimstinger Pfarrkirche St. Nikolaus geht zurück bis auf das 13. Jahrhundert. Reste vom Rippengewölbe und vermauerten Fenstern datieren auf etwa 1472. Die heutige, nahezu einmalige Form des Turmes stammt aus der Barockzeit um 1715. Die prachtvolle Kanzel, sowie der Hochaltar, stammen aus der Stiftskirche von Herrenchiemsee, die im Zuge der Säkularisation 1803 in den Handel gekommen sind und für die Kirche St. Nikolaus erworben werden konnten. Erwähnenswert ist noch, dass die Brüder Joseph und Georg Ratzinger 1951 hier in der Kirche ihre Nachprimiz feierten. Aus Joseph Ratzinger wurde dann am 19. April 2005 Papst Benedikt XVI.

Im Allgemeinen sind die Gottesdienste in St. Nikolaus in Rimsting:

Sonntag 10.00 Uhr  
Dienstag 19.00 Uhr  
Donnerstag 7.30 Uhr

properties.name: Church of St. James the Elder in Hofau
properties.description:
Unified late Gothic small church.

The nave and the chancel of the church, with the continuous roof and the western roof turret, form a single unit in the exterior.

Only inside are they separated by a triumphal arch.

properties.name: Football FC Bad Wörishofen
properties.description: **Bei Interesse kontaktieren Sie bitte den TSV Bad Wörishofen.**

properties.name: Parish Church of "St. Sebastian" Gilching
properties.description: Together with the parish hall at Hochstift-Freising-Platz, the parish church of "St. Sebastian", consecrated only in 1963, a modern central-plan building with a tent roof and free-standing bell tower, forms the spiritual center of the municipality of Gilching in the southwest of Munich.

properties.name: Dirt Park Pfaffenhofen
properties.description: Since 2019, cyclists have been able to really let loose at the new Dirt Park at Kuglhof. Spanning approximately 1,800 square meters, the park features numerous custom-designed trails and ramps for riders of all skill levels. Thanks to its free admission and the variety of trails in beautiful surroundings, the Dirt Park has become very popular. Age is no barrier—even the very youngest riders are already trying their hand at riding the tables on their balance bikes. The Funsportpark has since become a place to connect with other cyclists. Anyone who wants to get a taste of cycling or improve their riding skills can sign up for the workshops offered by the City Youth Services.

properties.name: Römervilla Möckenlohe
properties.description: If you have always wanted to feel like a Roman lord of the manor, Möckenlohe is just the place for you. A typical Villa Rustica from the time around 200 AD was built here as a replica on the ancient foundation walls and cellars still visible in places and offers the opportunity to enter provincial Roman living culture in the literal sense. Objects found on the site give a vivid impression of the life of the inhabitants. Old breeds of animals and ancient types of grain give an impression of ancient agriculture.

properties.name: ZEIT+RAUM Museum (ZEIT+RAUM Museum)
properties.description: Visitors can explore Germering's pre- and early history in the ZEIT+RAUM Museum (ZEIT+RAUM Museum). The region on the edge of the Munich gravel plain is rich in archaeological finds. With selected pieces, from the Stone Age to the Middle Ages, the permanent exhibition traces the complex and continuous history of settlement in the west of Munich. In addition to vessels from the Neolithic Bell Beaker Culture (ca. 2550-2000 B.C.), the exhibition includes grave goods from early medieval tombs dating from the 6th to 8th centuries. The museum is the starting point for information panels and museum units distributed throughout the city, which, such as a Roman brick kiln, focus on selected epochs at the site of the find.

properties.name: Synagoge und Jüdisches Museum Augsburg Schwaben
properties.description: The Augsburg Synagogue was built between 1914 and 1917 by Heinrich Lömpel and Friedrich Landauer. The 29-meter-high dome, decorated with Art Nouveau ornaments, rises over the sacred space. A side wing houses the Jewish Museum Augsburg Swabia. A permanent exhibition presents the eventful history of the Jews in Augsburg and the rural Jewish communities in Bavarian Swabia, as well as the history of the synagogue. Architecturally, the Augsburg Synagogue is one of the most significant synagogues in Europe.

properties.name: Church of St. James in Rottenstuben
properties.description: The small Church of St. James was built in the mid-15th century on the small plateau.

properties.name: Chapel of Christ's Painful Rest
properties.description:
Die Rastkapelle wurde im Juli 1648 von dem Herrschaftsverwalter Wolf Scheer gestiftet. Aufgrund des dreißigjährigen Krieges, des dadurch resultierenden Raubgesindels und der schrecklichen Pest erhielt die Kapelle ihren Namen. Durch Blasius Maß aus Rosenheim (1632 - 1692) wurde eine fast lebensgroße Statue des Heilands, das Kreuz an seinen Rücken gelehnt auf einen Felsen sitzend, geschaffen.

Die Kapelle kann auch im Rahmen einer Wanderung auf dem [Aschauer Kapellenrundweg (Rundweg 2)](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/Media/touren-gps/Wandern-auf-dem-Aschauer-Kapellenweg-Rundweg-2-Von-der-Pfarrkirche-in-Richtung-Sueden-und-zurueck) besucht werden.

properties.name: Riesengebirgsmuseum Marktoberdorf (Giant Mountains Museum Marktoberdorf)
properties.description: Representing the 1800 displaced persons who found a new home in Marktoberdorf and the surrounding area in 1946, the figure of Rübezahl, patron saint of the Krkonoše Mountains, reminds visitors of their lost homeland in Marktoberdorf. He accompanies visitors through eight rooms on an exploratory tour of the treasures and traditions of his country of origin.

properties.name: Parish Church "Maria Schutz" Pasing
properties.description: Mächtig ragt der 60 Meter hohe Turm des neoromanischen „Doms zu Pasing“ über die Stadt-Silhouette Münchens im Westen der bayerischen Landeshauptstadt. Maria selbst – der Schutzpatronin Bayerns – wurde die 1918 geweihte Kirche unter der Schirmherrschaft König Ludwigs III. von Bayern gewidmet.

properties.name: Museum Kulturgeschichte der Hand
properties.description: Vom Handlesen über Hand-Arbeit und Handzeichen hin zu Handschriften, Fingerfertigkeit oder Hand-Verwandten aus dem Tierreich: Im Museum Kulturgeschichte der Hand findet sich viel Wissenswertes rund um unsere Hand als „wichtigstes Werkzeug des menschlichen Gehirns“.

properties.name: Lech Weir Landsberg
properties.description: An absolute MUST on every visit to Landsberg is the beautiful view over the Lech weir. Whether with the picturesque Mutterturm in the background - seen from Flößerplatz - or with the panorama of Landsberg Old Town in the background - seen from the St.-Laurent-du-Var Promenade - the view of the rushing water makes every resident of Landsberg's heart beat faster.

properties.name: Wallfahrtskirche St. Salvator
properties.description:
# Origin

According to tradition, its origin is owed to a desecration involving a host. A woman from Siggenham is said to have gone to communion unworthily in the parish church of Prien, but not consumed the host; instead, she took it with her. After she was seized by remorse halfway home, she is said to have laid the host on the ground at the spot where the high altar now stands, where it immediately sank into the earth. This was interpreted as a miracle, which led to the construction of a church.

Evidence of the first building dates back to the 12th century. The pilgrimage to "Our Dear Lord above Prien" demonstrably flourished as early as the Late Middle Ages and reached its peak in the 17th century, when 18 parishes and cross processions came here every year. Since the 19th century, however, the pilgrimage has been in steady decline and has recently largely died out.

The church standing here today was completely rebuilt in the Late Gothic period, in the third quarter of the 15th century, and consecrated in 1472 by Bernhard von Kraiburg, Bishop of Chiemsee. The Late Gothic church building has come down to us with later alterations, although the exterior, with its characteristic saddleback tower, has preserved the original character quite purely. Later additions include the spacious porch attached to the west side, an early Baroque structure from 1639, and the sacristy from 1860, which does not really suit the plain church building and stands on the opposite side of the presbytery to the east.



# The church today

The church is closed because of its valuable furnishings. It is open only during services. Services at St. Salvator take place regularly on every last Friday of the month at 7 p.m.

Guided tours by appointment with the parish office in Prien, tel.: +49 (0)8051 1010

Another sight worth seeing is the [honorary bronze plaque for Joseph and Georg Ratzinger](http://www.rimsting.de/aktuellstartseite/sonstige-bekanntmachungen/121-ehrenbronzetafel-fuer-josef-und-georg-ratzinger.html), commemorating the brothers Ratzinger's post-primitial Mass in Rimsting and the planting of a pope's lime tree on the Ratzinger Heights.

On the Rimsting village walking trail, you can learn more about St. Salvator Church.

properties.name: St. Gallus Church
properties.description: It is said that Martin Luther secretly left Augsburg during the night of October 20 to 21, 1518, from the small Church of St. Gallus. Friends opened a small gate for him in the city wall, because the “heretic” Luther was threatened with death at the stake. At St. Gallus Church, a stone plaque with the inscription “Da Hinab” commemorates this event.

properties.name: Pfarrkirche St. Ulrich und Johannes Baptist Schwenningen
properties.description:
Visible from afar, the Catholic Parish Church of St. Ulrich and St. Johannes Baptist dominates the Schwenningen townscape.
In the battles of 1703/1704 during the War of the Spanish Succession, the former church suffered severe damage. Therefore, a stately new building was erected in 1720 according to plans by the master mason Andreas Moosbrugger and consecrated in 1740. The lower stages of the tower date back to the late Gothic 13th century.

Inside, one can admire the ceiling paintings by court painter Augustin Laur, which depict important scenes from the lives of St. Ulrich and St. Sebastian. The images are elegantly framed by the stucco work of Balthasar Suiter. The three altars date from 1879 and are in the Neo-Renaissance style. Especially beautiful is the main altarpiece, which shows the preaching of John the Baptist in the wilderness. The painting was created in 1833 by Kaspar Braun. In shell niches on the walls stand figures of the twelve apostles and other saints. On the south wall of the nave, an oversized cross from the 15th century draws the eye.

properties.name: Lamaranch Kleinaitingen
properties.description: A varied range of activities from a short walk (approx. 1.5 hours) with grooming together to extended trekking tours lasting several hours with a snack in the Lech meadows or the natural paradise of the Western Forests.

properties.name: Catholic Parish Church of the Assumption of Mary
properties.description:
Towering powerfully above Kirchgasse is the Catholic parish church of the Assumption of Mary, rebuilt after the fire of 1783 by Johan Baumgartner. As we know from descriptions, the Miesbach church was a major work of the Baroque Miesbach stucco sculptors’ school (after the Wessobrunn school, the best-known stucco sculptors’ school in Old Bavaria) and the important Miesbach woodcarving tradition from the Late Gothic to the Rococo. Nothing remained after the fire except the masonry core of the choir, the buttresses, and the base of the tower. The church was erected as a simple hall church from 1783 to 1786.

Characteristic of the exterior are the elegant early Neoclassical tower top and the pleasing broken choir roof. The rich Neo-Romanesque decoration of the church, in which the self-image of Miesbach’s prosperous bourgeoisie of the 19th century was manifested (as in the town hall), was removed in 1936/37 and then completely in 1962/63. The interior appears bare, and therefore renovation is also planned in the near future.

Preserved is the pilgrimage figure of the "Mater Dolorosa," rescued from the flames and carved in 1665 by Johann Millauer, which in 1963 was inserted into the then newly assembled crucifixion group with two side figures, hanging freely in the choir. The body of Christ was carved by Roman Anton Boos before 1783. This imposing crucifixion group is the focal point of the church interior.

properties.name: Stadtmuseum Neuburg a. d. Donau (City Museum Neuburg a. d. Donau)
properties.description: The local Stadtmuseum Neuburg a. d. Donau (City Museum Neuburg a. d. Donau) shows that Neuburg a. d. Donau is a "small town with a great past". It tells of the myth of an old town, of water supply, boatmen and fishermen. About the cornerstones of the urban community - secular rule, spiritual power, trade and bourgeoisie. And of course about the people of Neuburg, their coexistence and their path from the Middle Ages to the present day.

properties.name: Museum für Vor- und Frühgeschichte - Archäologische Sammlung an der Mittleren Alz (Museum of Prehistory and Early History on the Middle Alz River)
properties.description: 4000 years ago, the Garching region experienced a period of prosperity that lasted, with interruptions, for around 1000 years. The Museum of Prehistory and Early History reminds us of this. The collection focuses on Bronze Age finds from the Margarethenberg, the chariot grave from Hart a. d. Alz, the Roman villas of Höresham and Tacherting and the Bavarian burial ground in Garching a. d. Alz.

properties.name: St. John's Church in Grabenstätt
properties.description:
Die Johanneskirche, erbaut im gotischen Stil im Jahr 1400, hatte an derselben Stelle bereits eine romanische Vorgängerkirche und ist als Taufkapelle urkundlich nachgewiesen seit 959. Bemerkenswert sind vor allem die 1969 frei gelegten gotischen Fresken mit der mächtigen Figur des hl. Christophorus.

Neben dem Portal der Johanneskirche ist ein römischer Grabstein in die Kirchenmauer eingelassen – eine Infotafel erläutert die Geschichte des Grabsteins. Weitere Informationen unter [www.roemerregion-chiemsee.de](http://www.roemerregion-chiemsee.de)

Öffnungszeiten: Juni – Oktober täglich von 8 bis 18 Uhr sowie zu den Gottesdienstzeiten, ebenso auf Anfrage über das Kath. Pfarramt Grabenstätt.

properties.name: St. Michael's Fountain
properties.description: The doctor Michael Gschwändler demonstrated the healing effects of the moor with the first experiments and, as a country doctor, at that time cared for the entire area of the former district. This deserving citizen of Bad Aibling laid the medical and scientific foundations for the spa with his research. In memory of the "moor pioneer" Michael Gschwändler, St. Michael's Fountain was erected by his sons.

properties.name: Former Pilgrimage Church of Saint Florian in Frasdorf
properties.description:
Ursprünglich im Stil der Spätgotik erbaut und mit drei gotischen Altären ausgestattet, wurde sie Anfang des 18. Jh. barockisiert und Mitte des 19. Jh. regotisiert. Auch die Hochzeit der Wallfahrt war bis zum 19. Jahrhundert. Auch der verschollene Wolfgangsaltar, kehrte nach 140 Jahren Abwesenheit und einer Reise um die Welt, mit Stationen in Amerika, Belgien und Freising, 1994 wieder in seine Kirche zurück.  

Die Kirche ist vermutlich Anfang des 15. Jahrhunderts entstanden und verdankt ihren Ursprung offensichtlich der nahen, als wunderkräftig geltenden Quelle, über der sich eine kleine Kapelle erhebt. Man sprach diesem Wasser heilende Wirkung bei Augenleiden zu. Die Quelle war auch schon vor der Kirche bekannt und vermutlich damals von einem hölzernen Brunnenhäuschen umgeben. Heute ist nur noch der marmorne Brunnenaufsatz in dem Häuschen zu finden, aber kein Wasser mehr im Brunnen. Auch der Patron der Kirche, der heilige Florian weist auf den einstigen Brunnen hin, da er oft als Patron von Brünnlein und Quellen genannt wird. Im Jahre 1659 wurde, an Stelle der alten Holzkapelle, die heutige Brunnenkapelle aus Stein von Georg Steindlmüller d. A. von Schlechtenberg erbaut und zuletzt 1898 renoviert.

**Die Kirche wird ehrenamtlich betreut!**  
Führungen von Mai bis September an jedem ersten Sonntag im Monat, an diesen Sonntagen ist die Kirche zur Besichtigung von 14 bis 17 Uhr geöffnet. Jeweils um 15 Uhr wird eine kostenlose Führung angeboten. Im Winter ist die Kirche geschlossen.

Weitere Kirchenführungen sind nach Absprache mit dem Pfarrbüro Frasdorf, Telefon +49 (0)8052 958980,  
oder Hildegard Osterhammer, Telefon +49 (0)8052 2452, möglich.

properties.name: Parish Church of St. John Mallersdorf-Pfaffenberg
properties.description: Die 1109 mit dem Bau begonnene ursprünglich romanische Pfeilerbasilika erhielt um 1750 ihre heutige Form in Barock und Rokoko. Bis zur Auflösung in der Säkularisation diente sie dem Benediktinerkloster als Abteikirche.

properties.name: Museum Penzberg – Sammlung Campendonk (Museum Penzberg - Campendonk Collection)
properties.description: The expressionist painter Heinrich Campendonk (1889-1957) is at the centre of the Museum Penzberg. He came to Bavaria from the Rhineland in 1911 and became the youngest member of the artist group "Der Blaue Reiter" (The Blue Rider). In order to be able to exhibit even more works from the extensive Campendonk collection, the museum building was extended in 2016.Pitch coal was mined in Penzberg over a period of 170 years, until 1966. The listed old building of the museum was built in 1873 as a workers' dwelling. This type of house shaped the appearance of the town as a "colony". One of the former six flats in the house was furnished with contemporary furniture and household effects from around 1920.Another room is dedicated to the memory of the "Penzberg Murder Night" in 1945.

properties.name: Steinling Chapel on Kampenwand
properties.description:
The chapel was built in honor of Josef Hell, the builder of the Chiemgau Cross, and in memory of those who fell in both World Wars. In 1976, the small house of worship was consecrated in honor of "Mary, Queen of Peace." Since then, a solemn memorial service has been held every year on the last Sunday in August under the open sky.

Against an impressive mountain backdrop, a mountain mass is held every year on the last Sunday in August below the summit cross erected as a memorial at **Kampenwand Chapel next to Steinling Alm**. In remembrance of the war dead and the missing from the Chiemgau region, the more than 400 participants, including flag delegations, mountain riflemen, and musicians, make the memorial ceremony a very special and extraordinary event.

Would you like to get married on Kampenwand? A church wedding is also possible in Steinling Chapel.

Further information can be found at [Wedding on Kampenwand >>](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/chiemsee/congress/house/Aschau-iChiemgau-Eventlocation-SonnenAlm-Kampenwand-DEU000000607023336594)

properties.name: Deutsche Barockgalerie und Sammlung Haberstock im Schaezlerpalais (German Baroque Gallery and Haberstock Collection in the Schaezlerpalais)
properties.description: In der Deutschen Barockgalerie sind mehr als hundert bedeutende Meisterwerke der Malerei des 17. und 18. Jahrhunderts aus den Sammlungsbeständen der Stadt Augsburg und verschiedener Leihgeber ausgestellt.Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf Werken der in Augsburg tätigen Barockmaler, darunter Joseph Heinz, Johann Evangelist Holzer und Matthäus Günther. Während die Gemälde von Johann Heinrich Schönfeld und dem Künstlerkreis der frühen Augsburger Akademie einen Eindruck zur Malerei des Frühbarock vermitteln, zeichnen die Werke von Johann Bergmüller und seinen Schülern Holzer und Günther die Entwicklung zum Rokoko nach, deren Ausklang anhand von Arbeiten von Anton Graf, Anton Raffael Mengs und ihren Zeitgenossen nachzuvollziehen ist. Die Gliederung der Ausstellung in verschiedene Themengruppen soll das vergleichende Betrachten erleichtern.In der Karl und Magdalena Haberstock Stiftung im zweiten Stock sind herausragende Gemälde z. B. von Lukas Cranach d. Ä., Anthonis van Dyck, Giovanni Battista Tiepolo, Paolo Veronese, Canaletto, Nicolaes Berchem oder Jacob Jordaens zu sehen.

properties.name: Sudetendeutsche Stuben und Schlesierstube (Sudeten German parlors and Silesian parlor)
properties.description: Das Schicksal der in Massing ansässig gewordenen Schlesier und Sudetendeutschen steht im Mittelpunkt dieser Dauerausstellung. Zahlreiche Exponate erinnern an die alte Heimat und die Vertreibung nach dem 2. Weltkrieg.

properties.name: Priener Regional Market
properties.description:
### Accessibility


- Parking available
- Accessible

properties.name: St. James Church in Urschalling
properties.description:
St. James is probably unique in its wealth of imagery. Hardly any sacred building has revealed so many surprises over the centuries.


### Origins

At the height of the Romanesque period, commissioned by the Counts of Falkenstein, Urschalling was painted for the first time. The entire interior of the church is covered by a cycle of paintings that was already whitewashed over in 1600. At the end of the 14th century, a cycle was created that—preserved in full—sets the history of salvation before our eyes.

The value of the frescoes lies in their completeness and their large, period-specific form. World-famous is a controversial depiction of the Trinity.


### Worship and visits

A Eucharistic celebration takes place in Urschalling Church on the second Friday of every month at 7 p.m.

[Church tours are possible >>](https://www.tourismus.prien.de/erlebnisse/kirchenfuehrungen-chiemsee/)


### Film location explorer

The feature film "Hinterdupfing" was partly filmed in St. James Church in Urschalling.

properties.name: Kegeln im Gasthof zur Mühle
properties.description: Whether in a large or small group; whether as a beginner or a pro; whether to relax or to work up a sweat: bowling is a popular, classic leisure sport and is great fun together.

properties.name: Wasserturm Kleinaitingen
properties.description:
Der Kleinaitinger Wasserturm ist auf der Lechfeld-Ebene seit mehr als 100 Jahren ein weit erkennbares Wahrzeichen.

Er wurde zur Sicherstellung der Wasserversorgung der Gemeinde in den Jahren 1912 bis 1914 von italienischen Gastarbeitern errichtet. Er ist auch aus heutiger Sicht noch immer als eine architektonische und technische Meisterleistung zu betrachten.

Für die Wasserversorgung hat er keine Bedeutung mehr.

properties.name: Kath. Pfarrkirche "St. Anton"
properties.description:
The parish church of St. Anton in Hausham was built in 1905 in the Neo-Baroque style and forms the religious center of the community. The bright interior is simply and harmoniously designed, complemented by a few artistic elements from the time of construction.

Regular services:

Wednesday: 7:00 p.m. - Eucharistic celebration

Saturday: 7:00 p.m. - Eucharistic celebration

Sunday: 9:00 a.m. - Eucharistic celebration (Croatian community), 10:30 a.m. - Eucharistic celebration

properties.name: Escape-the-City Augsburg – The Golden Medal
properties.description:
In “The Golden Order,” Augsburg becomes an outdoor escape room. The team follows the trail of a mysterious order, combines clues found on-site, and solves the challenges along the route.

Unlike purely digital outdoor games, this experience includes a physical game kit: After placing your order, the case file and evidence will be mailed to your home. All you need is a smartphone; no app is required. Once the package arrives, you can choose your own game day and start time.

The adventure is designed for 2 to 8 people and lasts about 2 to 3.5 hours. Shipping within Germany is included in the team price of 79.90 euros and usually takes 4 to 5 business days. The starting point is Am Roten Tor, 86161 Augsburg. The exact route remains part of the game.

properties.name: LA Projects
properties.description:
LA Projects ist ein privater Kunstraum im Herzen der mittelalterlichen Stadt Landshut und befindet sich in einem restaurierten Handwerkerhaus aus dem 14. Jahrhundert. Der Ort verbindet historische Bausubstanz mit einem internationalen, interdisziplinären Ausstellungskonzept und schafft damit einen besonderen Rahmen für zeitgenössische Kunst.

Im Mittelpunkt des Programms steht die Präsentation international bildender Kunst sowie von Fotografie, Architektur und Design. Dabei werden die klassischen Disziplingrenzen bewusst überschritten. Die gezeigten Positionen verstehen sich als Ausdruck intellektueller und spiritueller Auseinandersetzung, in denen innovative Techniken und schöpferische Prozesse zusammenwirken. Leitgedanke ist dabei die Idee einer "Rettung desSichtbaren ins Unsichtbare", wie sie in einem Gedanken von Rainer Maria Rilke anklingt.

Geprägt wird das internationale Programm durch das langjährige Engagement des Gründers im deutsch-amerikanischen Kulturaustausch. Daraus entwickelt sich der Anspruch, LA Projects als Ort des transatlantischen Dialogs zu etablieren. Der Kunstraum versteht sich somit als Plattform für den Austausch zwischen den Künsten sowie angrenzenden Disziplinen wie Literatur und Sozialwissenschaften und trägt zur internationalen Vernetzung der Kunstszene bei.

properties.name: Heimat- und Torfmuseum Gröbenzell (Museum of local history and peat Gröbenzell)
properties.description: Das Museum führt den Besucher in die Lebensumstände der Bevölkerung um die Gründungszeit der Siedlung ein. Besonderes Augenmerk haben die Gestalter des Museums auf die Torfgewinnung in den Mooren um Gröbenzell gerichtet. Anschaulich gestaltete Schautafeln und Dioramen zeigen die geologische Entwicklung des Moores, wie es für die Dachauer Gegend typisch ist.

properties.name: KASiMiR Museum
properties.description:
The KASiMiR Museum is a museum for children and young people and is located in the LANDSHUT Museum in the Old Franciscan Monastery. It offers changing hands-on exhibitions from Tuesday to Sunday, aimed at children, young people, and families, and provides playful ways to explore the history of the city and region.

The offering is complemented by an extensive museum education program. Guided tours and workshops are offered for school classes and kindergarten groups, which deepen the respective exhibitions and make learning in the museum interactive. The KASiMiR Museum thus combines cultural education with a playful approach to the museum world.

properties.name: Parish Church of St. John the Baptist in Oberdietfurt
properties.description:
Late Gothic complex from the 15th century.

Neo-Gothic high altar with late Gothic wing reliefs from around 1500. Figures from the Late Gothic period.

properties.name: Naturmuseum
properties.description: The exhibition at the Natural History Museum presents exhibits from the fields of mineralogy, geology, ecology, and zoology. Unique in southern Germany is the "Molasse Exhibition": it shows the fossil fauna of the Tertiary period. The Stadtsparkasse Planetarium is located in the same building. It takes visitors into outer space, to planets and stars.

properties.name: Süddeutsches Fotomuseum
properties.description: Auf etwa 100 m² zeigt das Süddeutsche Fotomuseum in Bad Wörishofen die Geschichte der deutschen und internationalen Fotoindustrie, der Konstrukteure, der Händler, Labore und auch der Fotografen dar. Dabei wird die technische Entwicklung seit den Tagen der Urväter wie Niepce, Daguerre, Talbot, Hill, Steinheil oder Kobell über bahnbrechende Erfindungen und Entdeckungen wie die der Trockenplatte oder der Farbfotografie bis hin zu den ersten digitalen Aufnahmegeräten veranschaulicht - sozusagen "von Daguerre bis Digital".

properties.name: Apocalypse Museum
properties.description:
Im Stadtteil Sulzbach bei Aichach befindet sich das „Apokalypse-Museum“ in einem historischen Bauernhaus. Dort werden zwei beeindruckende Zyklen des verstorbenen Künstlers Adolf Ziegler aus Friedberg ausgestellt.  

Das Museum zeigt insgesamt 128 großformatige Bildtafeln, die sich intensiv mit der Geheimen Offenbarung des Johannes auseinandersetzen. Diese bestehen aus 64 Silberoxyd-Reliefs und 64 farbenprächtigen Glasfenstertafeln, die erstmals in ihrer Gesamtheit der Öffentlichkeit zugänglich sind.

Für Interessierte sind Führungen das ganze Jahr über nach vorheriger Vereinbarung möglich.

properties.name: Apothekarium Neubiberg
properties.description: Das Apothekarium ist ein Apothekenmuseum im Südosten von München und lädt zu einer faszinierenden Reise durch die Geschichte der Pharmazie ein. In einem kombinierten Wohn- und Geschäftshaus von 1950 werden historische Standgefäße aus Holz, Glas und Porzellan bis hin zu antikem Arbeitsgerät aus Bronze und Messing sowie exotische Objekte aus vergangenen Apotheken und Wunderkammern präsentiert. Es bietet Einblicke in die Entwicklung der Apothekenkultur, von praktischen Gebrauchsgegenständen bis hin zu kunstvollen Möbeln und dekorativen Stücken.

properties.name: Multi-generational Park Kurpark Prien am Chiemsee
properties.description: In the multi-generational park in Kurpark Prien am Chiemsee, various fitness equipment is available for exercises.

properties.name: "Johann Nepomuk" Chapel, Pasing
properties.description: The Johann Nepomuk Chapel at the Pasing Würm Bridge in a small green space is representative of the great veneration of the bridge saint in Bavaria. Built in 1700 by Count von Berchem, the chapel was destroyed in the Second World War and was not restored to its former state and consecrated again until 1963.

properties.name: Christ Church (Evangelical Lutheran)
properties.description:
Eine evangelische Gemeinde in Landsberg besteht erst seit Mitte des 19. Jhs. Am 6. Dezember 1913 wurde der Grundstein für die Kirche auf einem Grundstück am damals noch weitgehend unbebauten westlichen Lechufer gelegt. Die Kirche erbaute der Münchner Architekt Johannes Schmidt 1913/14.

Der reich gegliederte Außenbau mit Turm und Treppenerker setzt mit seiner gelben Farbigkeit am Beginn der Von- Kühlmann-Straße einen städtebaulichen Akzent.

Innen wird der Saalraum durch die Holzemporen und dem sargdeckelartig abgeschrägten Deckengewölbe beherrscht, das durch Holzbahnen in Felder gegliedert ist. Ursprünglich hatte die Kirche, vor allem im Altarraum und auf der Orgelseite eine dekorative Ausmalung. Nach dem zweiten Weltkrieg ersetzte man die Dekorationsmalerei des Chors 1951-1952 durch eine Darstellung der vier Evangelisten und eines Posaunengels des Malers Erich Horndasch. Zusätzlich bemalte Horndasch die bis dahin freien Putzfelder des Gewölbes mit alttestamentlichen Darstellungen, die zum Teil stark stilisiert sind. 

1990 gestaltete man den Platz vor der Kirche neu und stellte einen Brunnen auf.

properties.name: Heimathaus Neuchl-Anwesen
properties.description: In the "Neuchl-Anwesen", a small farmhouse dating from 1829, the original room functions with parlour, kitchen, dining room, etc. on the ground floor were restored and the upper floor was reserved for other exhibition areas such as folk piety, traditional costume parts and school objects.

properties.name: Schwäbisches Handwerkermuseum (Swabian Craftsmen Museum)
properties.description: Old crafts come to life again in the former fountain master's house of the hospital at the Red Gate from the 18th century. Numerous workshop facilities present not only traditional craftsmen such as the shoemaker, tessellator, stonemason and plasterer, but also comparatively young professions such as the radio and television technician or office machine mechanic. The museum is located on the "Handwerkerweg", a facility that shows visitors traditional crafts still carried out today in businesses throughout the city, most of which have existed for several centuries.

properties.name: Escape-the-City München – Der Goldene Orden
properties.description:
In “The Golden Order,” Munich becomes an outdoor escape room. The team follows the trail of a mysterious order, combines clues found on-site, and solves challenges along the route.

Unlike purely digital outdoor games, this experience includes a physical game kit: After placing your order, the case file and evidence will be mailed to your home. All you need is a smartphone; no app is required. Once the package arrives, you can choose your own game day and start time.

The adventure is designed for 2 to 8 people and lasts about 2 to 3.5 hours. Shipping within Germany is included in the team price of 79.90 euros and usually takes 4 to 5 business days. The starting point is Praterwehrbrücke, 80538 Munich. The exact route remains part of the game.

properties.name: Feldkapelle St. Josef
properties.description: Die Feldkapelle St. Josef in Schnuttenbach wurde durch ehrenamtliches Engagement im Jahr 2003 durch die Bürgerschaft errichtet.

properties.name: Gundelfingen Fitness Trail
properties.description: The fitness trail in Gundelfingen attracts visitors with 20 varied exercise stations. The circular route covers 2.3 km and leads through the beautiful floodplain forest along the Danube. Parking is available at the sports facilities.

properties.name: Hochablass Waterworks
properties.description: Driven by the power of the Lech and Wertach canals, Augsburg became an industrial city early on from the mid-19th century, and the population grew rapidly. Soon the water towers of the waterworks along the eastern city wall were no longer sufficient to supply Augsburg with drinking water: the waterworks at Hochablass was built. It went into operation in 1879, and its technology attracted attention throughout Europe. Behind the Neo-Renaissance façade lies technology from the Augsburg Machine Factory. The Lech water in the Neubach drove the turbines and thus, until decommissioning, three double-acting piston pumps. They drew drinking water from basins beneath the engine house, which was fed from collector wells in the Siebentischwald. Via intermediate ten-meter-high pressure air vessels, the water was forced into the pipes.

properties.name: Lohwinden Pilgrimage Church
properties.description:
The Pilgrimage Church of the Nativity of Mary in Lohwinden traces its origins to a miraculous healing that took place in 1666. Johannes, a shepherd from the Salzburg region, was healed of his muteness. According to tradition, he worked for a farmer in Lohwinden and, while tending the animals, would often pray before a small statue of the Virgin Mary set up outdoors. One day, while praying the Hail Mary, he regained his speech. As word spread that a man who had been mute from birth had regained his voice at the statue of the Virgin Mary in Lohwinden, more and more people flocked there from all over the surrounding area.  

In 1679, the first chapel was built, and 22 years later, construction began on the current pilgrimage church. It was completed after nine years of construction and consecrated in 1721.

properties.name: Church of St. Peter in Schwabering
properties.description:
The history of the church dates back to the early Middle Ages, with the first documentary mention around 924. In the 12th/13th century, the first stone church was built, with a late Gothic choir added to the Romanesque nave. The church was consecrated for the first time by the Salzburg auxiliary bishop Berthold von Hippo and then a second time in 1506 by the auxiliary bishop Nikolaus of Salzburg. This was probably due to the Landshut War of Succession.
Around 1749, the interior of the church was Baroquized by Hanns Plankl. A few years later, the sacristy was expanded with the addition of an upper floor. The church was last renovated in 1814.

As the population of the municipality had increased significantly, the construction of a new church was decided around 1856 and completed by 1860. On 23 September 1860, Archbishop Gregor von Scherr consecrated the new house of worship. The interior renovation was carried out according to contemporary principles by Hugo Williroider from Hochstätt on the Inn.

properties.name: Dreieinigkeitskirche - evangelische Kirche
properties.description:
Die evangelische Kirche in Bad Endorf wurde 1952 auf der Anhöhe Eisenbartling errichtet.

Direkt neben der Kirche lässt sich zusätzlich auch ein Bodendenkmal als neu errichtete Station der Römerregion Chiemsee bestaunen.

Hier wurden Ausgrabungen eines historischen, römischen Gutshofes gefunden.

properties.name: Church of the Sacred Heart
properties.description: The Catholic parish church of the Sacred Heart in Augsburg's Pfersee district, consecrated in 1910, is the largest Art Nouveau church in southern Germany. The stylistically pure interior furnishings make this church unique in Germany.

properties.name: Pfarrkirche „Mariä Himmelfahrt" Weilheim
properties.description: In the center of Weilheim, at Marienplatz, stands the parish church of the Assumption of Mary, which is among the largest architectural monuments in the Pfaffenwinkel, so richly blessed with sacred buildings.

properties.name: King Ludwig Pavilion Nature Observation Station
properties.description: The King Ludwig Pavilion, with its permanently installed binoculars (fee required), offers a wonderful view of Lake Chiemsee, Herreninsel with Herrenchiemsee Palace, and the Chiemgau Alps. Plants, trees, waterfowl, and fish can be observed here in all varieties.

properties.name: Pilgrimage Church of the Visitation of Mary in Anzenberg
properties.description: The pilgrimage church in Anzenberg is described as the most beautiful Rococo church in the district. The high altar, a work by the sculptor Wenzel Jorhann from 1746, is particularly magnificent. The church was built around 1750 and consecrated in 1757.

properties.name: Waterworks at the Red Gate
properties.description: Mit drei Wassertürmen, zwei Brunnenmeisterhäusern und dem gemauerten Aquädukt, durch das noch immer ein Kanal fließt, ist das Wasserwerk am Roten Tor ein vielleicht weltweit einzigartiges Denkmal der Trinkwasserversorgung und seit 2019 ein zentrales Objekt des UNESCO-Welterbes „Augsburger Wassermanagement-System“. Wohl seit 1433 versorgte der Große Wasserturm des Wasserwerks die Reichsstadt mit Trinkwasser. Ein Hebewerk förderte das Quellwasser des Brunnenbachs in ein Reservoir im Turm, von wo es in die Röhrleitungen strömte. Der später zweimal aufgestockte Große Wasserturm ist im Kern der älteste erhaltene Wasserturm Mitteleuropas. 1464 wurde der Kleine Wasserturm daran angebaut. 1599 entstand der sogenannte Kastenturm. Alle drei Wassertürme wurden auf den Fundamenten von Stadtmauertürmen errichtet. 1777 ersetzte das mit sieben Bögen gemauerte Aquädukt, über das bis 1840 das Quellwasser des Brunnenbachs in das Wasserwerk geleitet wurde, einen aus Holz konstruierten Vorgänger. Im Oberen Brunnenmeisterhaus lag die Dienstwohnung des Stadtbrunnenmeisters, im Unteren Brunnenmeisterhaus die Werkstatt des Wasserwerks, das bis 1879 in Betrieb war. Bis heute fließt der Brunnenbach unter dem Wasserwerk hindurch ins benachbarte Lechviertel. Das Obere Brunnenmeisterhaus und der Kleine Wasserturm beherbergen heute eine Dauerausstellung zur Geschichte der Trinkwasserversorgung Augsburgs.

properties.name: Gut Morhard Animal Paradise
properties.description: Gut Morhard is not just an animal sanctuary. Sharing knowledge with others is a top priority. Through numerous projects, visitors are introduced to nature and the animal world.

properties.name: Nähmaschinenmuseum (Sewing machine museum)
properties.description: 380 sewing machines from 140 years: The museum in the monastery laundry in St Ottilien invites you on a journey through the history of the sewing machine. Numerous rarities from all over the world can be marvelled at, such as one of the first functioning models from 1866, the first electric sewing machine from 1924, a designer machine from 1957 and a series of children's and doll sewing machines.

properties.name: Stadtbad
properties.description:
The Landshut municipal swimming pool offers a wide range of opportunities for sport, relaxation, and leisure all year round. With a varied selection of an indoor pool, outdoor pool, and sauna area, it is one of the city’s popular leisure facilities and provides ideal conditions for active hours as well as relaxing breaks.

The indoor pool has around 600 square meters of water surface and invites visitors to swim and linger regardless of the season.  
During the indoor pool season, special offerings such as Aqua Zumba and mermaid swimming complement the regular bathing experience and combine exercise, fitness, and leisure fun in a varied way.

In the summer months, the spacious outdoor pool expands the range on offer. Five pools with a total of around 3,100 square meters of water surface provide plenty of space for swimming, splashing around, and cooling off.  
On around 38,000 square meters of sunbathing area, those seeking relaxation have ample room for sunbathing, unwinding, or enjoying a varied day outdoors.  
The expansive complex makes the municipal swimming pool a popular meeting place for families, recreational athletes, and those seeking relaxation alike.

The sauna area with its various saunas also provides soothing relaxation, inviting visitors to switch off after swimming or as a standalone wellness area. The combination of sporting activities, generous water areas, and relaxing wellness options makes the Landshut municipal swimming pool a versatile leisure and relaxation destination - regardless of weather or season.

properties.name: Hicret Mosque Lauingen
properties.description:
The Hicret Mosque is not only the place of worship for a large Turkish community from across the entire district. It is also an exceptionally interesting sight in Lauingen and reflects the good relationship between the locals and their Turkish fellow citizens. Many guests and visitor groups from all over Germany visit the "Hicret Camii" to learn about its distinctive architecture and the cultural life that brings together people of different faiths here.

Throughout Islamic history, mosques have always been places of social and cultural encounters and services. The mosque therefore houses not only a prayer room for 300 worshippers, but also various common rooms, washrooms, a youth café and a classroom for children who learn the Koran and Islam. Integration courses (German) and remedial classes (focus on German for third- and fourth-graders) are also held there. In addition, there is a library and a large room used by the women’s section for various preparations.

The mosque can be visited by anyone, regardless of origin or religion.

A kermes with an open day and mosque tours is also organized every year, and everyone is of course warmly welcome.

Mosque tours for groups can be arranged at any time by prior appointment.

properties.name: Kuhsee
properties.description: Der Kuhsee ist ein künstlich geschaffener See im Stadtteil Augsburg-Hochzoll. Er ist ein beliebtes Ausflugsziel für zahlreiche Sport- und Freizeitaktivitäten und günstig gelegen am Rande des Naherholungsgebiets Siebentischwald. Der Hochablass, die nördliche Begrenzung des Kuhsees, ist ein Augsburger Wahrzeichen und für Fußgänger und Radfahrer der Weg über den Lech. Seit 2019 ist das Lechwehr am Hochablass ein Objekt des UNESCO Welterbes "Augsburger Wassermanagement-System".

properties.name: Villa Rustica Leutstetten (Villa Rustica Leutstetten)
properties.description: Im heutigen Leutstetten befand sich im 2. Jh. n. Chr. ein römischer Gutshof (villa rustica). Die ergrabenen archäologischen Befunde – etwa eine gut erhaltene Fußbodenheizung – sind in einem schützenden Glaspavillion zu besichtigen. Der Grundriss des Hauptgebäudes ist im Gelände markiert. Gefäße, die mindestens 200 Jahre älter sind als die römische Villa und als zugehörige Funde ebenfalls präsentiert werden, lassen auf eine frühere keltische Siedlung schließen.

properties.name: Herrgottsruh Pilgrimage Church
properties.description: The pilgrimage church "Our Lord's Rest" was built from 1731 to 1753 and is one of the finest works of Bavarian Rococo. The collaboration of many masters represents the style's characteristic harmony of architecture, sculpture, and painting. The wall paintings are by Cosmas Damian Asam, the famous painter of the church of the same name in Munich. His student, the Augsburg fresco painter Matthäus Günther, created the dome frescoes. The stucco work is by Franz Xaver Feichtmayer.

properties.name: Schraml Bathing Area
properties.description:
The popular bathing beach with its large sunbathing lawn is located on the west side of the lake in the beautiful town of Prien am Chiemsee. Admission is free; only a parking fee applies. From this bathing beach, there is a beautiful view of Herreninsel and the Alpine range. The toilet facility was newly built in 2010 and the access to the water renaturalized.

For the really sporty, right next to the bathing area there is the largest climbing forest on the lake, the “[Kletterwald Prien am Chiemsee](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/entdecken/alle-sehenswuerdigkeiten/kletterwald-prien-am-chiemsee-f654f5c87e)”

**Food and drink:** Kiosk with large wooden terrace - Schraml Lounge

**Facilities and services:**

- Changing room and toilets
- Parking spaces (fee required)
- Deck chairs and parasols for a fee

**Leisure and sports activities on land:**

- Children's playground
- Beach volleyball court

**Water activities:**

- Boat rental with rowing boats, pedal boats, sailing boats, and electric boats
- Stand-up paddling equipment

**Barrier-free:**

- Accessible toilet available
- Barrier-free access to the lake

Further information at [www.schraml-chiemsee.de >>](http://www.schraml-chiemsee.de/)

properties.name: Sieben-Schwaben-Museum (Seven Swabians Museum)
properties.description: Meist kommen sie ja recht tölpelhaft daher, die „Sieben Schwaben“ aus der gleichnamigen Erzählung des Dichters Ludwig Auerbacher (1784–1847). Die Türkheimer nahmen ihm das aber nicht krumm und haben dem berühmten Sohn ihrer Stadt sogar ein Museum gewidmet. Die lokalgeschichtliche Sammlung zeigt außerdem vor- und frühgeschichtliche Funde, Objekte zur Ortsgeschichte, zu Handwerk und bäuerlichem Brauchtum, kirchliche Kunst, Trachten, Möbel, Schwäbische Landkarten sowie Originalzeichnungen und Druckgrafiken des ebenfalls in Türkheim geborenen Barockmalers Johann Georg Bergmüller (1688–1762).

properties.name: Roman Museum in the Zeughaus
properties.description: Until the reopening of the Roman Museum, the exhibition “Roman Camp. Roman Augsburg in Crates” in the Tuscan Column Hall in Augsburg’s Zeughaus presents highlights from the collections to the public — including numerous stone monuments and statuettes, ceramics and glassware, coins and weapons. Several exhibits convey the Romans’ style of living. The highlight of the exhibition is a once-gilded bronze horse’s head, probably part of a Roman equestrian statue. The focus of the exhibition is the relics of a Roman rafting harbor on the Lech found in Augsburg.

properties.name: Pilgrimage Church of the Presentation of Mary in Oberreit
properties.description:
The church was built in the 15th century, but it was remodeled in the Baroque style two hundred years later. Above all, the church tower was topped with a dome. The holy water font dates from the time of its construction and is decorated with the year 1477 and the coat of arms of the then castle owner of Altenburg, Wilhelm von Maxlrain.

In former times, many pilgrims and worshippers came to the church. The heyday of the local pilgrimage was during the grim era of the Thirty Years' War from 1618 to 1648. The altar also dates from this period. However, the miraculous image on the altar is much older still, a late Gothic carved work of art. Only the sacristy was created in the 19th century.

Other ornaments of the church are the stucco decorations, which are meant to symbolize the church's prosperity and divine protection over the souls.

properties.name: Anthal Golf Course - Lake Waging
properties.description: The beautifully scenic 9-hole course of Golf Club Anthal is located just 2.3 km outside the town center. At the tourist information office, you can pick up a voucher for 40 free balls to hit on the driving range. Rental clubs are provided free of charge at the golf club. A special wheelchair also enables people in wheelchairs to enjoy this great sport here.

properties.name: Parish Church of St. Margareta
properties.description: The Parish Church of St. Margareta in Mamming is an important representative of pre-Vatican II church architecture.

properties.name: Kirche St. Andreas Lauingen
properties.description:
The Lauingen Church of St. Andrew was first documented in 1416. Structural alterations were carried out in 1533, 1550/51, and 1554. During the Reformation, it served as a Protestant church. Today, the congregation gathers in Christ Church, a building from the 1950s, in the northwest of the city. After the Thirty Years' War, the city undertook the restoration of St. Andrew's Church. In 1721, a thorough restoration was carried out, and in 1725 the interior was given a Baroque makeover.

The church is designed as a single-nave building with a trapezoidal nave and a three-sided closed chancel with a segmental chancel arch. The ceiling paintings and the altarpiece were created by Johann Wilhelm Schreiner in 1721. Stucco work was carried out in 1725. The high altar was completed in 1699. The painting on the west side depicts the "Raising of Lazarus" from around 1720. The wooden figures are by Schifferle and Gröbner.

properties.name: Taxi-Funk Ingolstadt
properties.description:
Taxi-Funk Ingolstadt bietet zusätzlich zum normalen Personentransfer noch folgenden Service an:

Apotheken-Service
Rufen Sie uns an. Wir sagen Ihnen, welche Apotheke oder welcher Arzt Notdienst hat - soweit uns das möglich ist - und besorgen Ihnen auf Wunsch die nötigen Medikamente.

Pannenhilfe und Lotsendienst
Fremd in der Stadt? Rufen Sie uns an, wir vermitteln Ihnen einen zuverlässigen Pannen- und Abschleppdienst und bringen Sie und Ihr Fahrzeug auf Wunsch sicher und schnell zu Ihrem Ziel.

Fahrplan-Info
Wir informieren Sie über die aktuellen Ankunft- und Abfahrtzeiten der DB und bringen Sie und Ihr Gepäck pünktlich zum Bahnhof.

properties.name: Dollnstein brass band
properties.description: That's how long the Dollnstein brass band has been around, and over the years we have built up a considerable repertoire. To ensure that there is a "breath of fresh air" in the brass band in the future, we are happy to welcome boys and girls aged nine and over who are enthusiastic about playing - and by the way, even those who have already passed the age of 30 can feel like new blood!
